limits: No matched abiotic or open-circuit R4 time course
Consecutive batches are not independent reactor replicates
Whole-module and isolated-product mass balances unavailable
Figure 5 carbon-paper trace contains peaks at the same positions used to assign fcc silver
Local EDS purity differs from the solution-derived 86% estimate
Table 1 percentage-composition basis is unreconciled with the R4 aqueous feed

source_assessments.version: Version of record 20 January 2026, Carbon Neutrality 5:6
source_assessments.access: Full main 14-page PDF acquired; methods and PV-related results read. DOCX supplementary texts S1–S3, Tables S1–S3 read and Figures S1–S2 visually checked.
source_assessments.decision: Defer direct-PV bioleaching mechanism pending consistent feed and yield basis
limits: Main assay adds 500 mg silver powder to 250 mL medium, distinct from the PV-cell extension
SI S1 feed Ag is 2.13% versus SI S3 feed 10,980 mg/kg
SI S3 uses 2 g PV cells, while Table S3 reports 1 g/L loading; main liquid volume cannot be assumed for the SI arm
Provenance and pretreatment of actual PV-cell feed are incompletely specified
83.5% from solid-concentration decline alone does not demonstrate a closed mass yield
SI preliminary economic calculation assumes 95% leaching-reagent cost reduction and excludes collection, transport, crushing/separation and refining
Main omics associations and DFT do not prove every molecular mechanism
